cards.text: Jesus wraps up His teaching to the people and heads to Capernaum. There, a centurion, an army officer, has a servant he values highly. And that servant is sick and about to die.

cards.question: The centurion hears about Jesus and wants Him to come heal his servant. Who does the centurion send to ask Him?

cards.text: The elders come to Jesus and plead with Him earnestly, "This man is worthy to have You grant this," and friend, these elders show up like a reference letter with LEGS.

cards.question: The elders tell Jesus the centurion is worthy. What reason do they give?

answers.text: He loves our nation and built our synagogue
He feeds our poor and keeps the Sabbath
He fasts often and gives to the temple

cards.text: So Jesus goes with them. He's not far from the house when the centurion sends friends with a message, like that text that hits right as you pull into the driveway.

cards.question: True or false: The centurion's message tells Jesus to hurry inside before it's too late.

cards.text: Instead the message says, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy to have You come under my roof." Hold on. The elders JUST said he's worthy, and the man himself says he's NOT.

cards.question: The centurion sent others to Jesus instead of going himself. Why didn't the centurion come to Jesus himself?

answers.text: He was needed by his soldiers
He was too sick to travel

cards.question: The centurion doesn't want Jesus to trouble Himself coming under his roof. So what does the centurion ask Jesus to do so his servant will be healed?

cards.text: Then the centurion explains how he sees it. This man knows a thing or two about giving orders.

cards.question: The centurion says he himself is a man under ___, with soldiers under him.
True or false: The centurion says his soldiers argue with him before they obey his orders.

cards.text: He says, "I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes." Friend, I set my oven timer for twelve minutes once, and it went off whenever it FELT like it.

cards.question: Jesus hears the centurion's message about orders and authority. How does Jesus react to the centurion?

cards.text: Jesus MARVELED at him. The only thing I ever made marvel was a smoke alarm, and friend, that wasn't marveling, that was SCREAMING.

cards.question: Jesus turns to the crowd following Him and says that not even in ___ has He found such great faith.
The messengers head back to the centurion's house. What do they find there?

answers.text: The servant waiting at the door

cards.text: That servant was about to die, and now he's in good health. Somebody get that centurion a cookie box with his NAME on it.
